segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to review the renewal for the analytics workspace before the current term ends on June 30, and also talk through the five additional editor seats you mentioned.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that’s right. We’re at 42 users today, 18 editors and 24 viewers. Starting July we need 23 editors, same 24 viewers, so 47 total.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. On the annual plan, that puts the renewal at $38,760 for July 1 through June 30 next year. That includes the standard support tier and the usage cap you have now, 2 million tracked events per month.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The number is in the range I expected. Can you keep the billing annual, net 30? Finance really does not want quarterly invoices.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, annual invoice, net 30. Invoice would go out July 1 for $38,760, payable by July 31. No change to your payment terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing, our legal team asked last year about auto-renewal. We don’t want that added back in.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Same as the current agreement: no auto-renewal, fixed 12-month term, and we’ll reach out at least 60 days before the end date to discuss next year.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. For go-live on the extra seats, we need the managers added by July 8. Is that doable if I send the names this week?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If you send the five names by Friday, we can have the seats active on July 1, and your admin can assign roles anytime before the July 8 manager training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send me the order form with those terms and I’ll route it for signature. Our signer is Mark Ellis, VP of Operations.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it today with Mark as signer, 47 total users, annual billing, net 30, and the July 1 start date. Anything else you want reflected?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that covers it. Thanks, Alex.
